deck: Sazerac put the second-worst-rated advert of Super Bowl LX on the air in February. At 09:02 Eastern this morning Sazerac announced the sequel: a 500,000 dollar cheque for whichever member of the public makes the best 15-second spot, with Andy Cohen helping judge. tldr: Meta switches on a second way of counting conversions by default on 12 November, two weeks before Black Friday, and reported sales will rise without any campaign performing better.  Export your Meta-attributed purchases and your own order data this week, write down the ratio, and send it to whoever will read the December report.

Every one of the 30 brands in iSpot's third-quarter study converted at a better rate on streaming than linear, and 15 of them still got more conversions in total out of linear.  Recompute any streaming-versus-linear case as total conversions at your own reach before anyone presents it, and ask sellers for cost per conversion instead of conversion rate.

Connected television outspent cable on political advertising for the first time in a midterm, up 122 percent to 2.4 billion dollars while cable fell 26 percent, and pre-emption clauses are still bumping brand spots in contested states until the polls close tomorrow.  Get the list of your pre-empted spots and value the make-good inventory you were given, then hold flexible fourth-quarter weight until Wednesday.

Svedka finished 53rd of 54 on Ad Meter and 57 against a median of 100 on EDO's independent measure, and this morning offered the public 500,000 dollars for the next spot, around five percent of a 30-second rate card.  Put your own creative cost and media cost on one line this week and be ready to say what that ratio is buying.

7-Eleven shot a seven-episode vertical drama inside a real store with the food at every turning point, so the product cannot be trimmed out.  Apply one test at script stage on your next branded series: if you deleted the product from this scene, would the scene still work?  If yes, rewrite the scene.

A detector flagged 8.9 percent of 37,768 Meta advertising files as AI-made, only two of the 3,379 flagged files disclosed it, and the reassuring 3.5 percent figure for video exists because the scan had no audio.  Require provenance credentials and written disclosure of generated elements in every production contract you sign this month, and listen to the last five pieces of creator-style footage you licensed.

Proper DIY has 638,000 subscribers, a median of 290,948 views and no sponsor, having doubled his median by moving tool reviews to a second channel and narrowing to claim tests and single-technique masterclasses.  If you sell building products, approach him with a funded claim test and a written no-veto clause; if you do not, count how many of your last twenty uploads need the viewer to have seen a previous one, and move those off your main channel.
